traits.label: Versatility
traits.description: You begin with one additional tag skill.

traits.label: Ambition
traits.description: You may take one bonus perk at 1st level (any perk whose prerequisites you already meet).

traits.label: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 18 meters.

traits.label: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You resist charm and mind-affecting magic, and cannot be magically put to sleep.

traits.label: Woodland Stride
traits.description: Difficult terrain of plants and undergrowth costs you no extra movement.

traits.label: Sunless Sight
traits.description: Your darkvision extends to 36 meters, but you have disadvantage on checks in bright sunlight.

traits.label: Shadowmeld
traits.description: +10 to stealth while in dim light or darkness.

traits.label: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 18 meters.

traits.label: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You resist poison and disease, taking reduced damage from both. (Modeled as innate resist effects with parameter 'poison' and 'disease' granting +25% resistance.)

traits.label: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per level.

traits.label: Mountain Armor Training
traits.description: You are proficient with light and medium armor.

traits.label: Beastfolk
traits.description: Marks the race as beastfolk. A kin typically defines natural-weapon and heightened-sense traits, but no values are inherited from the template or from sibling kin.

traits.label: Retractable Claws
traits.description: Your claws are natural weapons dealing 1d6 slashing damage.

traits.label: Cat's Landing
traits.description: You take no damage from falls of 6 meters or less and always land on your feet.

traits.label: Pack Tactics
traits.description: +10 to attack checks against a foe that an ally is also engaging.

traits.label: Keen Smell
traits.description: +10 to detection checks that rely on scent.
